scope: Actual membership API, actor/shop boundaries, personal carts, shared commerce and existing delivery proof issuance. Live sockets and OIDC revocation are separate.
checks: only merchant accounts can read their own shop team
owner cannot invite a wholesale role or exceed bounded invitation expiry
one-use private invitations create individual password accounts in the existing shop
used and unknown tokens cannot create duplicate or standalone shops
invitation revocation and shop boundaries are checked at acceptance and management
a manager can invite buyers or viewers but cannot grant manager or owner powers
manager escalation, manager modification and stale access versions fail closed
shared shop addresses coexist with strictly personal baskets
favorites belong to the person rather than the shared shop
a shop buyer cannot acquire wholesale administration powers
reviewed price consent binds the actual buyer and shop; creation retains the person
owner, manager and viewer read the same shop order and frozen prices
viewer cannot commit or change shared commerce; buyers cannot change contacts or spend gifts
a person can edit their own profile without renaming the primary shop
shared messages retain their actual sender and remain read-only for viewers
people are excluded from wholesale customer and customer-tariff target lists
changing a manager role revokes existing sessions and unaccepted delegated invitations
revoked membership is retained and cannot fall back to an independent shop
suspending the primary shop disables every member account immediately
concurrent acceptance commits exactly one account and one permanent membership
a guest shop cannot issue a member invitation beyond its own authority lifetime
revoking a primary guest invitation immediately disables its shop and child members
delivery consent records the issuing person while binding the primary shop
